question: Find the value of [(23 times 16) timesleft{3 div 3 times ((19-13))/(3)right}]
solution:
**Given:**

[(23 × 16) ×left{3 ÷ 3 × ((19-13))/(3)right}]

**Formula used:**

Order of operations (BODMAS): Brackets → Orders (powers/roots) → Division/Multiplication → Addition/Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

[(23 × 16) ×left{3 ÷ 3 × ((19-13))/(3)right}]

⇒[(23 × 16) ×left{3 ÷ 3 × (6)/(3)right}]

⇒ [(23 × 16) ×left{1 × 2right}]

⇒[(23 × 16) × 2]

⇒ (368 × 2)

⇒ 736
